strings.name: Feng Zhang
strings.summary: Feng Zhang moved from optogenetics to genome engineering. His team applied CRISPR-Cas9 to mammalian cells and expanded Cas12, Cas13 and delivery tools. At MIT and Broad he advances disease models, diagnostics and potential therapies. CRISPR discovery and use reflect multiple groups' collaboration and competition; patent rulings do not allocate all scientific credit.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Advances CRISPR gene editing and molecular-engineering tools, influencing life-science experiments and potential therapeutic technologies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Harvard AB in Chemistry and Physics; Stanford PhD in Chemistry
strings.highlights.h1.title: Expanding cellular engineering
strings.highlights.h1.text: His teams advanced Cas9 editing in human and other cells and developed further DNA/RNA tools and delivery methods.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Scientific honors
strings.highlights.h2.text: He received the 2024 National Medal of Technology and Innovation in 2025 and joined the 2026 Inventors Hall of Fame class.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Patent priority reconsidered
strings.timeline.t1.text: After remand, the US PTAB again favored Broad's priority for specific eukaryotic-cell claims, not all CRISPR technologies.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Hall of Fame selection announced
strings.timeline.t2.text: MIT announced his selection for the 2026 class for CRISPR tool innovation.
strings.timeline.t3.title: National technology medal presented
strings.timeline.t3.text: At the White House he received the US medal corresponding to 2024.
strings.timeline.t4.title: RNA-targeting CRISPR
strings.timeline.t4.text: His team studied Cas13 systems, underpinning RNA detection and regulation tools.
strings.timeline.t5.title: CRISPR in mammalian cells
strings.timeline.t5.text: His team published Cas9 genome-editing research as other groups also advanced the field.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joining MIT and Broad
strings.timeline.t6.text: He established a laboratory focused on genome engineering.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Doctoral research completed
strings.timeline.t7.text: At Stanford he worked with Karl Deisseroth on optogenetic tools.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Harvard degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: He completed chemistry and physics before moving to Stanford.
